anomalies.impact: The EPD power rail has one tenth of the intended capacitance, reducing decoupling and potentially causing display-driver voltage droop, noise, or instability during boost/charge-pump transients.

parsed.summary: The build deviates from the specified EPD driver implementation by using a 0.1 uF/16 V capacitor for C1 where the specification calls for 1 uF/25 V; this reduces the intended decoupling on the display power rail.
